title: Independent live-data verification: Pri Shabbos deferred discussions and oral reports
scope: Public HTTP downloads of the production connected-ideas catalog, index HTML and connected-ideas.js; complete field comparison against the 18 approved source input records and all 996 saved baseline generated records. No browser interaction.

publicationContext.note: This report independently verifies the served release and bytes. Workflow completion, commit binding and rendered browser checks are documented separately.

baselineGeneratedRecords.description: Pre-addition snapshot supplied for independent comparison; compared as complete parsed JSON objects, including placement, evidence and reviewed context pins.

newRecords.sourceProjectionHashMethod: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted object keys, compact separators and unescaped Unicode, restricted to exactly the fields provided in the approved source record.

publicReaderAssets.verificationMethod: Inspection of downloaded public source bytes; this confirms the shipped version and rendering code, not a rendered DOM or browser interaction.

limitations: The production catalog is compared semantically by record fields; identical bytes or the same generated content hash as a local rebuild are not required. Production-only generated metadata outside the approved-input projection does not count as a new-note content difference.
The full 996-record baseline comparison does examine every generated field; its only permitted difference is the explicitly listed 95 Mei target text-file hash refreshes.
This report does not independently re-fetch every canonical source paragraph or repeat the bilingual editorial review; those checks are documented in the editorial audit and production gates.
This report does not perform rendered reader/browser checks, verify every CDN edge, verify workflow completion, or establish a separate Cloudflare worker deployment.
The failed initial sandbox network attempt occurred before any download; the first permitted public HTTP retrieval returned the expected v2 release, so no propagation retry was needed.
